scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'case "${npm_command:-}" in exec|run-script) exit 0;; esac; rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "!@workspace/api-server" --filter "!@workspace/majalis-mobile" --filter "!@workspace/majalis-pitch" --filter "!@workspace/majalis-promo" --filter "!@workspace/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "!@workspace/api-server" --filter "!@workspace/majalis-mobile" --filter "!@workspace/majalis-pitch" --filter "!@workspace/majalis-promo" --filter "!@workspace/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/majalis run test && pnpm run test:release-train && pnpm run test:safe-auto-merge
